verdict.rationale: The evidence documents usage-based pricing and meter events for recording usage. Nothing shows customers or the team viewing current-cycle usage or accrued cost in real time, and nothing shows usage thresholds or pre-invoice alerts. Meter events and generic webhooks are building blocks a developer would use to construct this, and the customer portal is only described as account management, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
